scenarios.name: Keep a pinned panel expansion through face selection and command cancellation

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Shell command is active with its properties and preview visible
the user opens and pins the Modify additional-command area
the user selects a solid face for Shell
the pinned additional area remains open
Shell remains active with one face selected and an updated preview
the Shell properties and preview close without creating a feature
the pinned additional area remains open
the user unpins the area and clicks its lower title
